nodes.label: ordersController.createOrderTracking -> POST /v2/checkout/orders/{id}/track
nodes.rationale: Tracking is pushed only after capture because Orders v2 tracking requires a capture_id.

nodes.label: Authorization Hold (Orders v2 intent AUTHORIZE)
nodes.rationale: Funds are held, never captured on agent say-so; UI says 'authorization hold' not 'escrow' because PayPal authorizations are not a licensed escrow service.

nodes.label: PayPal Orders v2 API
nodes.rationale: Create with intent AUTHORIZE, authorize after buyer approval; tracking only works on captured orders and needs capture_id.

nodes.label: SLA Breach Void (FR-07)
nodes.rationale: If deliver-by passes with no confirmed delivery, void the authorization after a human confirm; buyer never charged.

nodes.label: PayPal Authorization Rules (29-day validity, 3-day honor, reauthorize)
nodes.norm_label: paypal authorization rules (29-day validity, 3-day honor, reauthorize)
nodes.rationale: Deliver-by windows over 3 days need auto-reauthorize; windows over 29 days are rejected by the gatekeeper.

nodes.label: Void Flow (SLA breach or operator cancel)
nodes.norm_label: void flow (sla breach or operator cancel)

nodes.label: Gatekeeper Rule R8: Delivery window fits PayPal authorization validity
nodes.norm_label: gatekeeper rule r8: delivery window fits paypal authorization validity
nodes.rationale: PayPal authorizations valid 29 days with 3-day honor period; a mandate undeliverable in 29 days cannot be safely held, so reject before any PayPal call.

nodes.label: decisionSha256 binding
nodes.rationale: API verifies pass and hash before createOrder; stale mandate version yields DECISION_STALE.

nodes.label: Fastify HTTP Framework
nodes.rationale: D3: built-in schema validation and raw-body access per route needed for webhook CRC32.

nodes.label: pdf-lib Evidence PDFs
nodes.rationale: D10: pure JS, no Chromium on Render, deterministic output.

nodes.label: pg-boss Job Queue
nodes.rationale: D7: one fewer service to keep alive through judging; transactional enqueue with state changes.

nodes.label: Render Deployment (web, worker, cron, Postgres)
nodes.rationale: D11: sponsor prize, long-running worker, single render.yaml reproducible by judges; paid instances because free tier sleeps and free Postgres expires in 30 days.

nodes.label: Server-Sent Events to UI
nodes.rationale: D8: one-way server to UI is enough; works through Render proxy; trivial reconnect.

nodes.label: Dispute Evidence Assembly
nodes.rationale: Reason code is mapped to the evidence PayPal expects; bundle stored before sending; human confirms before filing.

nodes.label: PayPal Agent Toolkit (scoped read-only actions)
nodes.rationale: Narrowest actions per task, sandbox=true, e.g. products.list for sourcing; disputes.get and orders.get for defense.

nodes.label: provide-evidence precondition (provide_evidence link)
nodes.rationale: Submit re-fetches dispute and requires provide_evidence link; otherwise EVIDENCE_NOT_ALLOWED.

nodes.label: Hash-Chained Audit Log (FR-11)
nodes.rationale: Append-only, hash = sha256(prev_hash + canonical_json(payload)); tamper-evident and doubles as dispute evidence.

nodes.label: Kill Switch
nodes.rationale: One env flag disables all PayPal write calls, returning the app to read-only.

nodes.label: Append-only Trigger and No TRUNCATE Grant
nodes.norm_label: append-only trigger and no truncate grant

nodes.label: payments call.ts wrapper
nodes.rationale: All PayPal POSTs funnel through one wrapper that adds request ID, retries, debug_id capture and audit event.

nodes.label: Data model (nine tables)
nodes.rationale: WEBHOOK_EVENT and AUDIT_EVENT reference rows by ID in payloads, not FKs, so demo delete-and-reseed is never blocked.

nodes.label: Data rules (bigint minor units, timestamptz, UUID v7)
nodes.norm_label: data rules (bigint minor units, timestamptz, uuid v7)
nodes.rationale: Money never numeric/float so no rounding drift; API sends amounts as strings so bigints survive JSON; demo reset never deletes audit_event.

nodes.label: Sandbox dispute pool and require-evidence
nodes.rationale: A buyer cannot open two disputes on one transaction so the pool must be topped up; sandbox-only require-evidence moves UNDER_REVIEW to WAITING_FOR_SELLER_RESPONSE.

nodes.label: Five engineering rules
nodes.rationale: Money is bigint, PayPal writes via call.ts, transitions via transition(), every external effect writes audit event, agents cannot move money.

nodes.label: PayPal-Request-Id idempotency
nodes.rationale: Deterministic request ID reused on retries so a retried capture yields exactly one capture (test T2).

nodes.label: SQL migrations 0001-0004
nodes.rationale: 0002_audit_guard is irreversible by design: BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger on audit_event plus TRUNCATE revoke.

nodes.label: Observability: requestId, PayPal-Request-Id, debug_id
nodes.rationale: Three IDs per call let a grid failure trace to a log line and PayPal support in one step.

nodes.label: PayPal Server SDK 2.5.0 plus typed REST client
nodes.norm_label: paypal server sdk 2.5.0 plus typed rest client

nodes.label: @aegis/core package
nodes.rationale: Zero I/O shared types: money, schemas, order-state, canonical-json, hash, errors.

nodes.label: @aegis/payments package
nodes.rationale: The only package allowed to move money.

nodes.label: aegispay-nightly (cron)
nodes.rationale: Re-seed, dispute-pool upkeep, chain verify; skips rows updated in last 30 min to avoid touching live demo rows.

nodes.label: Evidence File Constraints and OAuth Scope update-seller
nodes.norm_label: evidence file constraints and oauth scope update-seller

nodes.label: PayPal JS SDK v6 Button
nodes.rationale: Matches /paypal:doctor v6 checks: createOrder resolves {orderId}, onApprove reads orderId, session.start gets invoked Promise.

nodes.label: Scheduled Work (SLA watcher, reauth, self-check, nightly)
nodes.norm_label: scheduled work (sla watcher, reauth, self-check, nightly)

nodes.label: Verified Webhook Ingestion (FR-08)
nodes.rationale: Ack 2xx fast, then verify and process in the worker; PayPal wants 2xx on every delivery and retries up to 25 times over 3 days. Corrects source report's 400-on-bad-signature design.

nodes.label: 29-day authorization validity and 3-day honor period
nodes.rationale: Capture after expiry gives 422 AUTHORIZATION_EXPIRED; reauthorize inside 29 days (P1) else void and re-approve.

nodes.label: Environment configuration (zod, fail fast)
nodes.rationale: Missing or malformed env vars stop the process at startup rather than failing at the first PayPal call.

nodes.label: Judge Mode (demo reset, clock offset, sandbox buyer banner)
nodes.norm_label: judge mode (demo reset, clock offset, sandbox buyer banner)
nodes.rationale: Clock offsets apply to SLA logic only via clock.now(); sandbox credentials shown only in sandbox.

nodes.label: Local development and sandbox setup
nodes.rationale: Webhooks need a public HTTPS URL (tunnel or Render); sandbox buyers need credit card funding source for chargeback-type disputes.

nodes.label: Poll fallback (pollOpen every 2 min)
nodes.rationale: Covers webhook delivery gaps by re-fetching open orders and disputes.

nodes.label: Secrets and log redaction controls
nodes.rationale: pino redacts authorization, client_secret, access_token, password; gitleaks in CI; .env git-ignored.

nodes.label: Webhook verification: offline CRC32 + RSA-SHA256
nodes.rationale: Simulator events cannot pass postback, so verified offline over id|time|WEBHOOK_ID|crc32 with cert allow-list and cache.

nodes.label: Channel3 (sourcing catalog API/MCP)
nodes.rationale: Catalog-only search/lookup; provides offers, product snapshots used in PayPal line items and as dispute evidence; sponsor prize $1.5k.

nodes.label: Deterministic Mandate Gatekeeper (FR-03)
nodes.rationale: Pure TypeScript, never an LLM, so spend limits cannot be talked around by prompt injection or model error; 100% branch coverage plus property tests of 200 random proposals.

nodes.label: Mandate
nodes.rationale: Operator-set budget, unit-price ceiling, deliver-by, spec and min rating; immutable once approved, hashed with SHA-256, and used as custom_id on the PayPal order so it doubles as a signed authorization record.

nodes.label: Proposal
nodes.rationale: One record per candidate the sourcing agent proposes; rejected ones are kept to tell the audit story.

nodes.label: Deterministic Money Math
nodes.rationale: Integer minor units; LLM output parsed to schema and re-validated; no LLM-computed totals reach PayPal.

nodes.label: Prompt-Injection Containment
nodes.rationale: Channel3 product text and dispute messages are untrusted data and never reach a prompt that can trigger a write tool without the gatekeeper.

nodes.label: Gatekeeper Rule R1: Mandate active and not expired
nodes.norm_label: gatekeeper rule r1: mandate active and not expired

nodes.label: Gatekeeper Rule R2: Proposal targets current mandate version
nodes.norm_label: gatekeeper rule r2: proposal targets current mandate version

nodes.label: Gatekeeper Rule R3: Unit price within ceiling
nodes.norm_label: gatekeeper rule r3: unit price within ceiling

nodes.label: Gatekeeper Rule R6: Total within remaining budget
nodes.norm_label: gatekeeper rule r6: total within remaining budget

nodes.label: Gatekeeper Rule R7: Arrives on time
nodes.norm_label: gatekeeper rule r7: arrives on time

nodes.label: Gatekeeper Rule R9: Supplier allowed and rated
nodes.norm_label: gatekeeper rule r9: supplier allowed and rated

nodes.label: Gate rules R1-R11 and Decision
nodes.rationale: One function per rule; Decision always returns all results plus total and decisionSha256 so API can reject DECISION_STALE or AMOUNT_MISMATCH.

nodes.label: API endpoint reference
nodes.rationale: Same-origin JSON validated by core zod schemas; session cookie and x-csrf-token on POST; webhook route never returns non-2xx.

nodes.label: SSE event stream
nodes.rationale: Events carry audit seq as id for Last-Event-ID replay; Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY drives them; ping every 15 s. Events: order.upsert, mandate.draft, agent.step, gate.decision, webhook.verified, dispute.upsert, selfcheck.result.

nodes.label: Build Plan to the Deadline (5-12 Nov)
nodes.norm_label: build plan to the deadline (5-12 nov)
nodes.rationale: Build the PayPal money loop first and the AI second; if P0 isn't green by 9 Nov, P1 is dropped.

nodes.label: FR-05 Fulfillment Tracking
nodes.rationale: PayPal only accepts tracking on captured orders, so tracking is stored in AegisPay and pushed after capture.

nodes.label: FR-12 Judge Mode
nodes.rationale: Pool of pre-seeded transactions and disputes because sandbox actions lag minutes and a buyer cannot open a second dispute on the same transaction.

nodes.label: Hackathon Deadline (12 Nov 2026 12PM PST)
nodes.rationale: About 6.5 days from the draft versus the report's 21-day plan, so scope is re-cut into P0/P1/P2.

nodes.rationale: Five equally weighted criteria; ties break in order starting with Technological Implementation, so PayPal integration breadth and correctness is prioritized.

nodes.label: Persona: Hackathon Judge
nodes.rationale: Must understand and verify the product in under three minutes; judges may use automated AI analysis, so repo must be self-explaining.

nodes.rationale: One Grand Prize + one Sponsor Prize max, so extra sponsors are insurance and goodwill, not additive cash.

nodes.label: PayPal-Request-Id Idempotency
nodes.rationale: sha256(orderRowId:action:attempt) truncated to 64 hex; attempt increments only on deliberate new attempt so retried capture returns original result (PayPal stores IDs 45 days).

nodes.label: Token Vault (FR-14)
nodes.rationale: Single-flight refresh when <15 min remain; on 401 invalidate and retry once, second 401 fails loudly and turns self-check red.

nodes.label: Agent Boundary / Least Privilege
nodes.rationale: No agent can call capture, void or provide-evidence; those are server functions behind the gatekeeper and a human confirm. Isolation is by toolkit configuration.actions and server code, not separate OAuth scopes (correction to report's 'mathematically incapable' claim).

nodes.label: Product Thesis: AI as orchestrator, not unbounded spender
nodes.norm_label: product thesis: ai as orchestrator, not unbounded spender
nodes.rationale: B2B/SMB chosen because consumer chat-to-checkout is crowded in the hackathon and is where the liability problem bites hardest.

nodes.label: Package Dependency Rules (eslint-plugin-boundaries)
nodes.rationale: Enforced in CI so 'agents cannot pay' is a checked property; README links the rule as proof.

nodes.label: pnpm Workspace Monorepo
nodes.rationale: D2: shared types between gatekeeper, server and UI; one README and LICENSE for Stage One.

nodes.label: @paypal/paypal-server-sdk (APIMatic-generated)
nodes.rationale: D4: toolkit lacks authorize/capture/void; Server SDK is typed and counts toward APIMatic prize; has no Disputes or Webhooks controller so a thin typed fetch client covers those.

nodes.label: Prompt and Safety Rules
nodes.rationale: Untrusted text passed in delimited data block; prompts versioned and hash logged; invalid structured output twice fails visibly.

nodes.label: Order Lifecycle State Machine
nodes.rationale: Only two transitions move money: Held to Settled via capture, and Held/In transit to Voided via void; both need recorded proof or human confirm.
